name: @teamlens/schema
description: Contract của TeamLens: OpenAPI (dashboard + CLI) và JSON Schema session chuẩn hóa v1

scripts.bundle: redocly lint openapi/openapi.yaml && redocly bundle openapi/openapi.yaml --output dist/openapi.yaml
scripts.generate:mcp: redocly bundle openapi/openapi.yaml --dereferenced --ext json --output dist/openapi.deref.json && node scripts/gen-mcp-tools.mjs dist/openapi.deref.json mcp
scripts.build: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run generate
